Pakistan, Turkiye to Deploy Forces in Saudi Arabia Amid Houthi Threats

Pakistan and Turkiye have agreed to provide military support to Saudi Arabia, reinforcing a collective defense agreement. Representatives from the three nations met to bolster regional security in response to threats from Houthi rebels. The deployment is part of the Mecca defense agreement.
